paper.note: Both swaps confirmed made in cardboard by the pilot: Astral Drift -> Shelter and Gleaming Bastion -> a basic Island. The lock was two changes behind — it still pointed at V3/v1.0.0 from 2026-09-21 while the working list had moved twice, so regen.is_pinned() was driving the whole chain against a list that was not in the case.

v0.1.0.note: the build: a 44-card Sharknado core and 24 named lands kept, the builder filled 18 spells and 12 lands

v1.0.2.note: Astral Drift -> Shelter and Gleaming Bastion -> a basic Island, both made in cardboard. The Island is the deck's first basic: Gleaming Bastion's W/U mode is gated on controlling one, so at zero basics it made {C} from the turn after it entered.
